about: Advisories npm audit reports that are accepted, each for one version of its package and in the projects named, with why (scripts/npm-audit.mjs). Only ones with no fixed release, or one still inside the 7-day cooldown (.npmrc) with its end date, from code that takes nothing from outside.

accepted.reason: no fixed release (micromatch/braces#72 unmerged); only build and development tools expand globs with it (shadcn's CLI, ESLint's Next.js plugin, ts-morph; Renovate for make updates), on the repository's own patterns, and the web app's image has none of it
no fixed release; only in Renovate's HTTP client (got, cacheable-request) for make updates, a dry run one person makes on their own machine: no cache there is shared between users
